editorial:
Imagine getting a late night call from your professor telling you to come back to campus for a final project. That is exactly what happens to the students in this flick. You get a group of college kids who think they are just finishing up their school work, but they quickly find out they are trapped in a deadly game. The vibe is very much like those old school slashers where the setting feels lonely and every dark corner could be hiding something scary. It sets up a tense mood right away, making you feel the panic as the students realize they are not alone in the building.

What really works here is how the tension builds up as the killer picks them off one by one. The acting is decent for this kind of movie, and the pacing keeps you moving without feeling too slow. While some of the kills are a bit predictable, it is still a fun ride if you love the genre. You should definitely try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best look, or maybe rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. If you are a big fan of physical media, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your collection is a great way to keep this gem.
endingExplained: In the final act, the mystery of the killer is finally revealed. After most of the students are gone, the survivors face a brutal showdown. You find out that the killings were tied to a dark secret involving the school and the professor. The last remaining student manages to fight back and escape just in time. It wraps up with a quick twist that suggests the nightmare might not be completely over for everyone involved.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves classic slasher movies and college horror settings.
